geopolitics_summary: EU Russia sanctions package clinched after Greek concession on gas transit; Middle East escalation raises LNG volatility; geopolitical premium to persist.

themes.headline: Greek concession unlocks EU Russia sanctions, freezes crude price cap
themes.why_it_matters: Resolution of EU sanctions deadlock removes policy uncertainty. Gas transit dispute resolution may affect Russian supply routing to EU; crude price cap freeze limits downside pressure on oil-indexed LNG arb into TTF.

themes.headline: Natural gas prices surge as Middle East violence escalates, Hormuz risk
themes.why_it_matters: Strait of Hormuz disruption risk directly pressures LNG supply to Europe. Traders pricing in permanent instability premium; Asian demand competition tightens global LNG spot, raising TTF forwards via arb channel.

themes.headline: EU methane rules test fossil fuel supply warnings; Commission skeptical
themes.why_it_matters: Methane regulations may reduce non-EU gas imports or force exporters to exit EU market. Desk exposure via supply elasticity: if regulation tightens, spot gas tightens and power-gas spread widens; if bluff called, oversupply risk.

themes.headline: NATO seals €27B multi-decade military fuel pipeline network overhaul
themes.why_it_matters: NATO fuel infrastructure modernization reduces European civilian fuel-military competition risk. Long-term capex commitment signals NATO energy security priority; minor upside to refined products and diesel supply stability.

themes.headline: Moscow-linked nuclear project in northwest Germany approved after safety review
themes.why_it_matters: New nuclear capacity in Germany increases non-fossil baseload, reducing day-ahead power spreads and evening out German power curve volatility. Downward pressure on average German DA and Cal+1 forward power prices.

watchlist: Middle East Strait of Hormuz disruption escalation; monitor Trump/Iran military actions for LNG supply shocks.
EU methane regulation implementation timeline and exporter push-back; supply contraction risk to TTF.
German nuclear project timeline; capacity online date and ramp schedule impact on DA curve.
Russia sanctions enforcement and gas transit routing changes; indirect impact on European supply diversity.
